source_reference: Tohoku, Chapter III, Section 3.6, proof of Proposition 3.6.2, p. 169

checks: The citation and formalization scope are limited to the compatible-resolution construction on canonical English p. 169.
The history limits the defect to the printed invocation of Proposition 1.9.2's generator assertion and preserves the compatible-resolution claim.
The repair uses the exact left adjoints F_i, their set-indexed generator coproduct, and evaluation preserving injectives.
No colimit resolution, T-acyclicity argument, or derived-colimit conclusion from Proposition 3.6.2 is imported.
The category A^I is explicitly the category of covariant systems over the small filtered poset I.
The transition morphisms of F_i cover exactly the identity B-to-B case and the unique morphism with zero source; an impossible B-to-zero boundary is not introduced.
The natural bijection Hom(F_i(B),M)=Hom(B,M_i) has the correct left-adjoint direction.
Exactness, kernels, cokernels, sums, filtered colimits, and AB5 are used pointwise.
The proper-component argument proves that the set-indexed family (F_i(U)) generates A^I.
Evaluation is the right adjoint with exact left adjoint and therefore preserves injectives.
Resolving inside A^I and evaluating gives compatible componentwise injective resolutions.
